_purpose: Human-readable spec สำหรับสื่อสารกับ PM, dev, QA — ใช้ก่อน sprint เริ่ม
_status: EXAMPLE — based on PDT-2880 with QA enrichment applied
title: View Pending Posts

user_story.role: admin with Can manage posts & comments permission
user_story.action: see all posts awaiting approval in one place
user_story.value: review and act on them quickly without missing anything or switching to desktop

preconditions: Admin is signed in and on the console home
Admin has 'Can manage posts & comments' permission
Admin is assigned to at least one community
At least one post is pending approval

business_rules.statement: Admin can only view and manage content from communities they are assigned to, across all content views.
Posts are sorted by created date in descending order (latest first) by default.
A pending post can be reviewed only once. The first action wins. Subsequent actions on the same post are rejected.
Only admins with 'Can manage posts & comments' permission can approve or decline pending posts.

given: admin taps the Pending filter within the Posts tab
then: a loading indicator is shown
empty state is NOT shown until data returns

given: admin is assigned to Community A and Community B only
then: only posts from Community A and Community B are shown
posts from Community C are NOT visible
posts are sorted by created date descending (latest first)
each card shows: author avatar, author name, community name, date and time, post content (title if any, text, media if any)
each card shows Approve button and Decline button

clarifications_needed.question: ถ้า author ถูก soft delete post card แสดง placeholder ยังไง? มี spec ไหม?

acceptance_criteria.when: the Pending tab label is visible
then: a badge showing the count of pending posts is displayed on the Pending tab label

clarifications_needed.question: badge count update แบบ real-time ไหม หรือ refresh เมื่อกลับมาหน้านี้?

then: empty state is displayed
badge is NOT shown on the Pending tab (not shown as 0, just hidden)

given: admin has 'Can manage posts & comments' permission
acceptance_criteria.when: admin taps Approve AND request is in progress
then: Approve button is disabled immediately to prevent double submission

given: admin has 'Can manage posts & comments' permission
acceptance_criteria.when: admin taps Approve AND the request succeeds
then: post is immediately removed from the pending list
badge count decrements by 1
success toast is shown to the admin

clarifications_needed.question: เมื่อ approve สำเร็จ post จะปรากฏใน Posted tab ทันทีไหม?

given: admin has 'Can manage posts & comments' permission
acceptance_criteria.when: admin taps Decline AND the request succeeds
then: post is immediately removed from the pending list
badge count decrements by 1
success toast is shown to the admin

clarifications_needed.question: เมื่อ decline แล้ว post owner ได้รับ notification ไหม?

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Post already reviewed by another admin
given: another admin has already approved or declined this post
acceptance_criteria.when: current admin taps Approve or Decline on the same post
then: toast message shown: 'Post has been reviewed'
no action is performed

acceptance_criteria.when: admin taps Approve AND network request fails
then: error toast is shown
post remains in pending list — state unchanged
Approve button returns to enabled state so admin can retry

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Approve last post — empty state transition
given: only 1 post remains in the pending list
acceptance_criteria.when: admin approves or declines it AND request succeeds
then: empty state is shown immediately
badge disappears entirely — does NOT show 0

given: admin A and admin B both view the same pending post
acceptance_criteria.when: admin A's request reaches the server first
then: admin A sees a success toast
admin B sees an error message
post reflects admin A's action only — approved state

given: admin is viewing the Pending tab
admin's permission is revoked by a Super Admin during the session
then: an error message is shown
the action is not performed

clarifications_needed.question: ถ้า permission ถูก revoke กลางคัน admin ควรถูก redirect ออกไปไหม หรือแค่ block action?

open_questions: CQ-1: soft deleted author placeholder spec
CQ-2: badge count real-time vs on-refresh
CQ-3: approved post visibility in Posted tab
CQ-4: post owner notification on decline
CQ-5: permission revoked — redirect or block only
